posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked:
TakeWalker:

Though I’m curious as to whether the Cult of Bloom is from the Plantverse or some kind of weird botanical Biomancer shenanigans. Or did Biomancer create the Plantverse, or rather, craft plant beings that would make us think there was another 'verse out there made of plant people? @_@ The possibilities are endless.

My take on the Cult of Bloom (and subsequent Whatever of Joy letter) was that Wager Master had used his power to change them and what they were all about. The Bloom letter even asked whether Wager Master had the power to permanently change a Cult and its object(s) of worship, which was the hint for me. Having Gloomweaver “pop in” to the Joy letter sounding very annoyed at whatever Wager Master had done was hilarious, and something I appreciated very much. Whether it was intentional on the part of the original Cult of Gloom, or if there was an imposter borrowing their persona I’m not sure (though I’m leaning towards the former), I was quite amused at the prospect of Wager Master messing around with Gloomweaver and his cult, while a frustrated Gloomy can’t figure out what to do with this annoying little imp or how to stop him…

WM: Hey Gloomy, why so sad? Did the heroes stop you again?
GW: What? Who are you and how did you get here? Nevermind, with my Eldritch pow-
WM: Maybe you should try lightening things up. Try for some flower power instead.
WM snaps his fingers. Gloomweaver finds himself in a sunny meadow, wearing a floral print summer dress.
GW: How did you–?
WM: Okay Bloomy, let’s make a wager…

Kinda makes me wish we had some stories where Wager Master messes with a villain or two for a change. There are some seriously funny possibilities in there.
